question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank No. 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **"enhance."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"enhance"** means to improve or make something better. (बेहतर दिखने के लिए, किसी वस्‍तु में सुधार लाना)

 
 
• **Example:** *These scandals will not enhance__ the organization's reputation.*
 
 
 
• It is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.
 
• Grammatically, this option fits the context of the sentence and makes sense.
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.
 
• Correct passage:

The Digital Saksharta Abhiyan (DISHA) or National Digital Literacy Mission (NDLM) Scheme has been formulated to __impart__ IT training to 52.5 lakh persons, including Anganwadi and ASHA workers and authorised ration dealers in all the States/UTS __across__ the country so that the non-IT literate citizens are __trained__ to become IT literate so as to __enable__ them to actively and effectively participate in the democratic and developmental process and also __**enhance**__ their livelihood.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Present: **to show something that you have prepared to people. ((किसी के सामने) प्रस्‍तुत करना)
 
• **Engage: **to interest or attract somebody. ((किसी को) आकृष्‍ट करना या (काम में) लगाना)
 
• **Train: **to teach a person to do something which is difficult or which needs practice. (किसी व्‍यक्ति को कठिन या अभ्‍यास की अपेक्षा वाला काम सिखाना, प्रशिक्षण देना)
